summary.text: Marty Causer is a Republican state representative from McKean County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 67 since December 2002 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is the Republican chairman of the House Energy Committee.

paragraphs.text: Causer graduated from the University of Pittsburgh at Bradford with a bachelor's degree in history and political science.

His earlier work included service as a dispatcher at the 9-1-1 center in Smethport and as a part-time police officer for Port Allegany, and he is a volunteer emergency medical technician and lifetime member of the Port Area Ambulance Service.
Ballotpedia also lists him as a former Annin Township supervisor.
Causer was named Republican chairman of the newly created House Energy Committee for the 2025-26 session.
He previously chaired the Policy, Agriculture and Rural Affairs, and Game and Fisheries committees, and he chairs the Legislative Timber Caucus and the Northwest Caucus.

His official biography describes him as an advocate for rural health care and emergency medical services, and he has authored legislation to increase Medicaid reimbursement rates for ambulance services.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Zach Ware as his opponent in the general election.
